description: This file defines the ConfigHelper class, which provides methods for interacting with configuration data in a database for the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to get, set, and delete configuration values, managing database schema introspection and query building.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A helper class to manage configuration data stored in a database table `hs_hr_config`. Provides methods to retrieve, update, insert, and delete configuration values, handling schema introspection and query building.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally accepts a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection, defaulting to a static method if none was injected.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for the current database connection.

methods.name: getConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by name from the database; returns default if not found.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets or updates a configuration value in the database for the given key.

methods.name: deleteConfigValue
methods.description: Deletes a configuration entry from the database by key.
